title: refactor(plugin-calendar,plugin-gantt)!: retire the flat fallback read; the calendar and gantt renderers read the block only
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBFijSMgUXzsRVhP3BchJpt1)_

Part of #25923

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md:290-301 and skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md:291-305 already teach the block only

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:日历和甘特图组件只从 `calendar` / `gantt` 配置块读取字段绑定，不再读取写在节点顶层的平铺字段;规范里两条拒收提示同步改掉了“渲染器仍会读取平铺写法”这半句。
- 为什么改:平铺写法早已被规范拒收、类型包也不再声明，两个视图生产者都只写配置块;对全部可达元数据的普查没有找到一行平铺存储，留着这条读取只是第二种方言(#12)。
- 风险与回滚:直接挂载 `ObjectGantt` / `ObjectCalendar` 组件并写平铺字段的宿主会看到“需要配置”提示而不是图表;回滚即还原本 PR，无存储数据迁移。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx`(`getGanttConfig` 与 `warnOnFlatGanttKeys`)、`ui/packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx`(`getCalendarConfig`)、`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`(两条拒收提示)。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.blockPrecedence.test.tsx packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.unconfiguredRefusal-7029.test.tsx`,预期全绿:平铺节点被拒并提示配置块，配置块节点正常绘制。
- 需要你做的:无，席位落地

## What changes

- `@object-ui/plugin-calendar`: `getCalendarConfig` reads the `calendar` block only. A node that writes `startDateField` / `endDateField` / `titleField` / `colorField` / `allDayField` flat with no block reaches the "Calendar configuration required" screen, whose hint names the `calendar` block. The package-local `ObjectCalendarFlatFields` and `ObjectCalendarHandoff` types are removed; `ObjectCalendarProps['schema']` is the published `ObjectCalendarSchema`.
- `@object-ui/plugin-gantt`: `getGanttConfig` reads the `gantt` block only. Flat `GanttConfig` keys with no block reach "Gantt configuration required", which now names the `gantt` block. The dev warning `warnOnFlatGanttKeys` names every flat key the chart did not read, with or without a block beside it. The legacy singular `dependencyField` is read nowhere. `ObjectGanttFlatFields` is replaced by `ObjectGanttSearchFields`, which carries only the `search` / `searchableFields` pair that `ListView` writes at runtime.
- `@objectstack/spec`: only the false clause of the `object-calendar` and `object-gantt` flat-key refusal texts is rewritten (they said the renderer still reads the flat spelling). The prescription itself, write the keys in the block, is unchanged.
- The three comment polishes from 6437594464: the dated #25923 notes in `calendar-flat-color-allday-8466.test.ts` merged and its read-census rows inverted; `objectql.ts` gantt block note; the `objectql.zod.ts` binding bullet and view-level arms note.
- Renderer and mirror tests that mounted a flat node now write the block; the tests that pin the refusal keep a flat node on purpose.
- READMEs of both plugins and the gantt demo moved to the block.

## Tests

- New and inverted pins: a flat calendar node and a flat gantt node are each REFUSED with a hint naming the block (`ObjectCalendar.unconfiguredRefusal-7029`, `ObjectGantt.blockPrecedence`), with a CONTROL that the same keys moved into the block draw. `ganttHandoff-25923.test.ts` (renamed from `ganttHandoffFlatFields-25923`) pins that the hand-off type carries only the search pair and that a flat `startDateField` is a compile error. `ObjectGantt.dependencyAlias` pins the singular alias as not read when written flat and refused by name inside the block.
- Census before and after (TS AST + JSON + YAML walk over 19,856 files, 14 parse failures, all JSONC tsconfigs): flat calendar nodes 12 to 7, flat gantt nodes 23 to 9; every remaining site is a test that pins the refusal or a type-level mirror pin. Zero sites in examples, apps, the console's shipped metadata, ui/examples, seeds, platform-objects or fixtures, before and after.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/functional-completeness.ts` and `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` are in the amended surface but were not edited: their calendar/gantt rows are dated readings pinned at objectui `b9814b334`, and no sentence in them becomes false with this change.
- No reference doc or refusal-text snapshot carries the old wording; the only other copy is the earlier `.changeset/25923-calendar-gantt-flat-keys-handoff.md`, left as written.
- `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/plugin-view` carry a `patch` entry. Their code changes are only comments and tests (in `@object-ui/types`), or none at all, but the item-1 changeset compiles into their changelogs too. So the Supersedes paragraph has to land beside it there as well.
- Both plugin entries are graded `patch`: `Metadata-protocol: none` takes patch under ruling A. The BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 marker stay.
- The item-1 changeset `25923-calendar-gantt-flat-keys-handoff.md` says the renderers still read the flat spelling. This PR does not edit it, because `check-empty-changeset` refuses a change to a changeset the merge base already carries. This PR's own changeset instead names the sentences it supersedes, in the same release.
- Unreachable for the census: hotcrm, tenant `sys_metadata` rows, cloud.
- Out of this PR, per the order: the `FormField` index signature, the `immutable` render-or-refuse follow-up, work item 2, and the list `options` bag (PR 2 closes the spec door with an ADR-0087 fold; PR 3 deletes the objectui readers).
